world.title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
world.description: The defence deal signed at the UN General Assembly also re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over its semi-autonomous Arctic territory.

world.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings
world.description: Three churches and three luxury hotels were targeted in the 2019 attacks which killed 270.

world.title: Ukraine anger as EU removes Russian oligarchs from sanctions list
world.description: Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman both have close ties to President Putin, and Kyiv said the move sent Moscow the wrong signals.

world.title: Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school

world.description: The attorney wants the court to look at the juror's mobile phone use and answers on questionnaires.

world.title: Top South African policeman charged with sexual offences

world.description: Doyle was best known for reporting on African conflicts in the 1990s and 2000s, notably in Rwanda and Sierra Leone.

world.description: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.

world.description: The news comes as part of a "reset" announced by Xbox in July, with 3,600 planned job losses overall.

world.description: The BBC goes inside the prison where prisoners were trapped in stifling, cramped conditions.

US.title: This 'fire amoeba' pushes the limit of what's possible for complex life

US.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 over deadly 2019 Easter bombings
US.description: The Islamic State group-inspired attacks were among the deadliest in Sri Lanka's history, killing 42 foreigners.

US.description: As the U.S. conflict with Iran drags, the Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen have opened a new front, taking new territory and displacing more than 100,000 people.

US.description: OpenAI beat humans to solving the Navier-Stokes problem, but mathematicians say the AI's solution isn't telling them much.

US.title: Abortion is on the ballot again as post-Roe policies continue to evolve
US.description: Four states will vote on abortion-related ballot measures in November. The measures follow the Supreme Court's "Dobbs" decision, which upended federal abortion protections.
